messages:
aman_support: Heads-up: escalating MapleThera (org: 'maple-thera') — onboarding pipeline blocked. Their bulk ingest job retried massively and now requests hit 429s from our router + unexpected billing spike. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-3499
 tasha_cs: Thanks Aman. Are they blocked from completing activation or is this intermittent? Also, what's the immediate renewal risk?
 aman_support: Blocked — activation can't finish. Their job ran with parallelism=32 which saturated our global cap due to a routing bug (tenant caps not honored). SDK v2.4.0. They also messaged theyre worried about cost estimates and asked for a pause.
 derek_csm: Ill take customer-facing comms. Proposal: immediate acknowledgement + temporary billing hold + short-term workaround (concurrency=8) + 11am ET bridge with engineering. Want SRE + CSM on bridge.
 lina_eng: Root cause: router-service was reading global rate limit instead of tenant-scoped config after a recent config migration. Hotfix ready to canary that respects tenant caps and adds soft-throttle. Canary ETA ~45m, full rollout ~2h if metrics look good.
 deploy_bot: Canary rollout started: job 90102 for router-service (canary). Monitor: https://ci.redwood.com/90102
 tasha_cs: Comm plan draft for MapleThera PM: 1) Acknowledge and apologise (now) 2) Immediate workaround: run ingest with concurrency=8 OR use our batch-upload tool (link) 3) We'll place a temporary billing hold while we investigate (pending finance ok) 4) 11am ET bridge with engineering + hourly updates until resolved 5) If issue >6h, propose onboarding credit and assign a dedicated onboarding lead.
 derek_csm: Sending that to the PM now. Also including a short ops snippet for their infra folks — pinging @lina_eng for exact command.
 lina_eng: Workaround snippet for their SREs:
 ```
 # reduce parallelism when calling the import API
 curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/import \
   -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   -d '{"source":"s3://bucket/path","concurrency":8}'
 ```
 Alternative: add header `X-Force-SoftThrottle: true` to queue client requests on our side.
 aman_support: Added workaround and instructions to ticket. Also added monitoring checks: watch router.429.rate and tenant.error_rate, alert if >5% sustained over 5m.
 tasha_cs: Ive flagged renewal_risk=HIGH if not resolved within 24h and opened an entry in the renewal tracker. Im ccing finance for immediate billing hold approval.
 derek_csm: On the bridge at 11am ET. If canary fails well escalate to temporary dedicated capacity for their onboarding window. :handshake:
